problem_type: Tool-group transitions invalidate reusable model context
symptom: Switching groups changes schema and system prefix on the next call.
direct_cause: Native request and skill unlock replace active tools; host filters prompt guidance by that menu.
class_root: Tool visibility and execution authority are coupled; stable guidance has no stable shared owner.
affected_population: Every native lane, restored session, model-requested group and skill unlock
internal_only_reason: The user has decided the internal residency budget and strategy. Installed pi public APIs already own activation, serialization and durable custom entries; no protocol changes.
invariants: Published schema constraints stay unchanged; total reachable schema tokens never exceed 10000.
Tool group switches do not remove tools or rewrite stable guidance.
Schema visibility cannot implicitly grant project file access.
generality_proof: All native entry points use one assembly and host. Stable schema and guidance are shared across transports; file access remains independently authorized using pi durable session entries.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Separate resident descriptions from coding authorization.
One selection sentence; full guidance remains in the stable system prompt.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Model group request reaches shared assembly.
Skill activation and restored histories converge on native assembly.

recurrence.reason: Every repeated group transition can recreate the prefix invalidation.
same_class_scan: rg laneToolMenu and menuForUnlock: native model request, initial assembly and host skill activation.
rg systemPromptFor and getActiveTools: host transform_context and restore.

prevention.invariant: Resident schema does not change with tool group requests; execution authority remains explicit.
prevention.failure_mode: Unknown group rejected; unauthorized project reads rejected; over-budget schema fails the gate.
prevention.strategy: Keep schema/guidance stable and persist authorization in the existing pi session.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove single-group retirement and active-only prompt filtering.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency bug; use existing activation and durable entry APIs.
exit_criteria: Re-run actual serializer and loopback prefix tests on pi upgrades.

migration: Restored sessions receive resident tools; existing coding access must be preserved without granting it to previously locked histories.
residual_risks: DeepSeek through the configured APIMart endpoint is measured; direct official endpoints and other model families are not paid-tested in this ≤¥1 sample.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Assembly determines tool residency and coding file access for all native callers.
